summary: Audited inventory for T1 item 1 (Design sources): 3 files (schematic design/vco.sch, derived netlist design/vco.spice and the regeneration script), each listed with its sha256; signoff/inventories.py --check re-derives the inventory from the live tree in CI. The netlist freshness gate 'design/netlist.sh --check' needs xschem and an IHP-Open-PDK install, which the signoff CI does not have: it did NOT run there, so this envelope does not assert the netlist is regenerated from the schematic -- only that both files are the bytes inventoried. Run the gate where xschem and the PDK exist.
